### GSE19668 (Mouse)

```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 = readRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2.rds")) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
GSE120661_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.csv"))


#Filter data
mouse_engerixb_metadata = GSE120661_metadata %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Engerix B",
         tissue == "PBMC") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = (timepoint / 24) %>% round(1),
         participant_id = paste0("ENG_BL_", animal_replicate)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7))

mouse_engerixb_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Get log2 values
mouse_engerixb_log2 = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  select(mouse_engerixb_metadata %>% pull(geo_sample))

```

#### Annotate genes

```{r}
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- mouse_engerixb_log2 %>% rownames()

#Get other annotations
listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

beep()

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_engerixb_log2summary = mouse_engerixb_log2 %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_engerixb_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_engerixb_log2summary = mouse_engerixb_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_engerixb_log2_filtered_probes = mouse_engerixb_log2 %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_engerixb_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(probe, mouse_entrez, human_symbol = hgnc_symbol, c(mouse_engerixb_metadata %>% pull(geo_sample)))
#14395
mouse_engerixb_log2_filtered %>% dim()



mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_engerixb_log2_filtered_probes %>% 
  select(human_symbol, c(mouse_engerixb_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol")


#Save 
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds"))
```

#### Import

```{r}
#Import
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Create Expression Set
eset_mouse_engerixb <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
    as.matrix(),
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_engerixb_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("geo_sample")))

#Save
eset_mouse_engerixb %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_eset.rds"))
```


```{r}
#Annotate
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_engerixb_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()
```


#### Differential expression (Limma)
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
eset_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_eset.rds"))

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_mouse) 
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #-0.02688727

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse, 
             design, 
             block = eset_mouse$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse_engerixb = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds"))

all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(n_degs = n())

```



#### Correlation plots, pairwise

Plot correlations between mouse samples across all timepoints using
pairwise scatterplots and density plots from the GGally package.

To do this, define custom plotting functions for densities on the
diagonal and points on the lower panels, then apply ggpairs to the
filtered log2 fold change expression matrix. Reorder the timepoints as
factors, color and fill by timepoint, and apply a custom theme along
with manual color scales.

The result is a matrix of correlation plots titled “All days,
HepB/EngerixB, GSE120661, C57BL/6J”.

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Plot correlation between animals ------
#Change params in geoms
#Density
my_dens <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping=mapping) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2, color = "black")
}
#Points
my_point <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, ...)  
}

#All timepoints
mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays = ggpairs(mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide %>% 
                                              mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
                                                     timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint))),
                                    columns = 3:7,
                                    mapping = ggplot2::aes(color = timepoint,
                                                           fill = timepoint),
                                    title = "All days, HepB/EngerixB, GSE120661, C57BL/6J", 
                                    diag = list(continuous = my_dens),
                                    lower = list(continuous = my_point)
                                    ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "#4361ee")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "#4361ee")) 

mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays

# Save
mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_samples_correlation_ggpairs_alldays.png"),
         height = 10,
         width = 10)
beep()
```

#### PCA

Perform a PCA on the **mouse** EngerixB dataset using log2 fold change
values from each **sample**.

Merge metadata with expression values, reshape the data into a wide
matrix with genes as rows and samples as columns, and replace missing or
non-finite values with zeros.

Run PCA on the transposed matrix to capture sample-level variation, then
extract the first two principal components and merge them back with
sample annotations.

Finally, plot PC1 versus PC2, coloring and filling by timepoint and
labeling by participant, with custom color scales and a themed layout.

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=5}

#Import
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))

#Input
samples_metadata_pca_input = mouse_engerixb_metadata
samples_log2fc_values_pca_input = mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long


#Import metadata
annotation_samples_pca = samples_metadata_pca_input %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_Day_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()


# PCA with raw values
clean_matrix_raw = samples_log2fc_values_pca_input %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_Day_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, human_symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  filter(!human_symbol == "") %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>% 
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#Plot
pca_raw <- pca_raw_df %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, 
             alpha = 1, 
             pch = 24, 
             color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple")) +
  labs(title = "Mouse, HepB, EngerixB, GSE120661",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank())
pca_raw 

beep()

```







#### BTMs

Annotate mouse genes with Blood Transcription Module (BTM) functional
groups and use them to assess correlations across timepoints. Load
pre-curated BTM annotations and clean the table of functional groups,
then merge it with an external list of immune-related genes. Map mouse
log2 fold change values to BTM processes by joining gene symbols with
their corresponding modules. For each participant and timepoint, compute
the mean log2 fold change per process, reshape the data into a wide
format, and attach module group information.

```{r}
#Import files
btm_annotation_genes =
  read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long.rds"))

#Annotate genes by BTM
samples_genes_btm = mouse_engerixb_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")


dge_btm_mean_process = samples_genes_btm %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

dge_btm_mean_process

dge_btm_mean_process_mouse = dge_btm_mean_process

dge_btm_mean_process_mouse %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_gsea_btm_mean.rds"))
```



##### Using GGPairs

Using this summarized BTM-level expression, generate pairwise
correlation plots with ggpairs, showing scatterplots and density plots
across modules, colored by timepoint. Add reference lines at zero, apply
custom color scales, and use a themed layout.

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Change params in geoms
#Density
my_dens <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping=mapping) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2, color = "black")
}
#Points
my_point <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5)  
}

#Create table
ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, timepoint %>% as.numeric)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#All days

mouse_correlation_ggpairs_btms_gsea_alldays = ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  ggpairs(columns = 3:7,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(color = timepoint,
                                 fill = timepoint),
          title = paste("All days"),
          diag = list(continuous = my_dens),
          lower = list(continuous = my_point)) +

                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "2" = "#caf0f8",
                                "3" = "#219ebc",
                                "4" = "#219ebc",
                                "6" = "#669bbc",
                                "7" = "#669bbc",
                                "12" = "purple"))

mouse_correlation_ggpairs_btms_gsea_alldays

mouse_correlation_ggpairs_btms_gsea_alldays %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_gsea_samples_btm_correlation_ggpairs_alldays.png"),
         height = 10,
         width = 10)

```

##### Using ggplot

Compute pairwise correlations of BTM module expression for five mouse
participants at a selected timepoint. Create unique participant pairs,
calculate Pearson correlations and R², and plot scatterplots with
regression lines, colored by module group, faceted by participant pairs,
and labeled with correlation values.

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#Sample 5 participants
set.seed(31415)

#Create table
ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, timepoint %>% as.numeric)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sample_participants_5 = ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(3:7) %>% 
  colnames()

#Inputs
timepoint_selected = 7


plot_data <-
  #Pivot longer, 1st participatn
  ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
               names_to = "participant_1", 
               values_to = "participant_1_value") %>%
  
  #Add a column to the 2nd participant
  inner_join(
    ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
      filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
      select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
                   names_to = "participant_2",
                   values_to = "participant_2_value"),
    by = c("process", "group")) %>%
  #Remove pares idênticos (mesma variável)
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
  
  #Remove dupes (ex: A-B e B-A → A-B)
  mutate(pair_min = pmin(participant_1, participant_2),
         pair_max = pmax(participant_1, participant_2)) %>%
  distinct(process, pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # Arrange participants to create a pairwise matrix
  mutate(
    participant_1 = factor(participant_1, levels = sample_participants_5),
    participant_2 = factor(participant_2, levels = rev(sample_participants_5)))


#Calculate correlation
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_1, participant_2) %>%
  summarise(cor_value = cor(participant_1_value, participant_2_value, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value ^ 2,
         cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2)))


#Plot 
plot_data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = participant_1_value, y = participant_2_value, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(data = cor_labels,
            aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label), 
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  facet_grid(participant_2 ~ participant_1, scales = "free", drop = T) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(x = "Log2FC", 
       y = "Log2FC", 
       color = "",
       title = paste0("Mouse, Hepatitis B, EngerixB Mouse, Day", timepoint_selected))
```

### GSE124533 (Human)

Download directly from GEO. The data is too large.

#### Prepare data

```{r}
#EngerixB: GSE124533 -----
filename = "GSE124533"
GSE124533 <- getGEO(filename = here("data_studies", "GSE124533_series_matrix.txt"), GSEMatrix = F)

#Metadata ------
GSE124533_metadata = GSE124533@phenoData %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    participant_id = "participant:ch1",
    sex = "gender:ch1",
    treatment = "treatment:ch1",
    ethnicity = "ethnicity:ch1",
    race = "race:ch1",
    age = "age:ch1",
    timepoint = "day:ch1") %>% 
  mutate(condition = treatment,
         organism = "Human",
         time_unit = "Day")
#Save
GSE124533_metadata %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_GSE124533_metadata.rds"))

#Import
GSE124533_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_GSE124533_metadata.rds"))


#Filter metadata
GSE124533_metadata_filtered = GSE124533_metadata %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("ENGERIXB1"),
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))


#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
human_engerix_log2summary = human_exprs_engerixb %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(probes_annotation %>% 
              rename(probe = gene_id,
                     entrezgene_id = entrez_id,
                     human_symbol = gene_symbol), 
            by = "probe") %>% 
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() 

#Filter out genes with multiple hgnc_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = human_engerix_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple hgnc_symbols
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

human_engerix_log2summary = human_engerix_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!human_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$human_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(human_engerix_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol,
         c(human_engerixb_metadata$geo_sample))

human_engerix_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = human_engerix_log2_filtered_probes 

human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
```

#### Differential expression (Limma)


##### Create expression set
```{r}
#Import
human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata_filtered = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))

human_metadata_filtered = human_metadata_filtered %>% 
  mutate(age = str_remove(age, "y") %>% as.numeric() %>% scale(),
         timepoint = as.factor(timepoint),
         sex = as.factor(sex),
         race = as.factor(race))

#Create Expression Set
eset_human <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
    as.matrix(),
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(human_metadata_filtered))

#Save
eset_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_eset.rds"))
```



#####Limma
```{r}
#Import
human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata_filtered = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_eset.rds"))

#Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + sex + age + race + 0, eset_human) 

#Avoid blank spaces
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

#Get intra-individual correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_human, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_human$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.22

# Fit
engerix_human_limma_fit <- lmFit(eset_human, 
                                 design, 
                                 block = eset_human$participant_id, 
                                 correlation = corfit$consensus)

# Contrasts
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  timepoint1 - timepoint0,
  timepoint3 - timepoint0,
  timepoint7 - timepoint0,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(engerix_human_limma_fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# Extract
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTable(fit2, coef = i, adjust.method = "fdr", number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
})


# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  #Clean table
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "EngerixB_Day1",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "EngerixB_Day3",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "EngerixB_Day7",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)

all_degs_human %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarize(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
```

##### Ggplot manual

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}

#Create table
ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, timepoint %>% as.numeric)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Input
timepoint_selected = 7

#Plot table
plot_data <-
  #Pivot longer, 1st participatn
  ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
               names_to = "participant_1", 
               values_to = "participant_1_value") %>%
  
  #Add a column to the 2nd participant
  inner_join(
    ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
      filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
      select(timepoint, group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process", "timepoint"), 
                   names_to = "participant_2",
                   values_to = "participant_2_value"),
    by = c("process", "group")) %>%
  #Remove identical pairs
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
  
  #Remove dupes (ex: A-B e B-A → A-B)
  mutate(pair_min = pmin(participant_1, participant_2),
         pair_max = pmax(participant_1, participant_2)) %>%
  distinct(process, pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # Arrange participants to create a pairwise matrix
  mutate(
    participant_1 = factor(participant_1, levels = sample_participants_5),
    participant_2 = factor(participant_2, levels = rev(sample_participants_5)))


#Calculate correlation
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_1, participant_2) %>%
  summarise(cor_value = cor(participant_1_value, participant_2_value, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value ^ 2,
         cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2)))

#Plot 
plot_data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = participant_1_value, y = participant_2_value, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(data = cor_labels,
            aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label), 
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  facet_grid(participant_2 ~ participant_1, scales = "free", drop = T) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(x = "Log2FC", 
       y = "Log2FC", 
       color = "",
       title = paste("Human, Hepatitis B, EngerixB Human, Day", timepoint_selected))
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

```{r}
  if (!is.na(mat[i, j]) && mat[i, j] > 0) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.f", mat[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, color = "white"))
  }
                           i# Add significance stars based on p-value thresholds
  if (!is.na(pvalue_matrix[i, j])) {
    pval <- pvalue_matrix[i, j]
    sig <- ""
    if (pval < 0.01) {
      sig <- "***"
    } else if (pval < 0.05) {
      sig <- "**"
    } else if (pval < 0.10) {
      sig <- "*"
    }

    if (sig != "") {

    }
  }
},
```

###Plot correlation
```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_samples =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds"))

human_mouse_engerix_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

all_degs_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC") %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = timepoint /24,
         timepoint = timepoint %>% as.character())



#Pivot wider
human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  #Add padj columns
  inner_join(all_degs_human %>%
               bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
               select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, adj_p_val) %>%
               pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
                           values_from = "adj_p_val") %>%
               rename(padj_human = Human, padj_mouse = Mouse)) %>% 
  #Drop genes that are absent in one of the organisms 
  drop_na()

# Calculate the correlation
cor_data <- human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(padj_human <= 0.05 | padj_human <= 0.05) %>%
  summarize(
    cor_value = cor(Mouse, Human, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    label_pos_x = max(Mouse, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_pos_y = max(Human, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2)))
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=3}
ylim_range = c(-2.5, 2.5)
xlim_range = c(-2.5, 2.5)
human_mouse_log2fc_log2fc_avg_wide_scatterplot = human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  
  #Filter DEGs only
  filter(padj_human <= 0.05 | padj_mouse <= 0.05) %>%
  
  #Plot
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Mouse,
      y = Human) +
  
    #Add lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  
  #All DEGs
  geom_point(color = "gray90") +
  
  #Facet
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint), ncol = 1) +
  
  #DEGs in both organisms
  geom_point(color = "#4DBBD5FF",
             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1.5,
             size = 1,
             pch = 21,
             data = human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
               #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
               filter(padj_human <= 0.05 & padj_mouse <= 0.05 & sign(Human) == sign(Mouse))) +
  
  #Immune DEGs
  geom_point(color = "#4361ee",
             fill = "#4361ee",

             size = 1,
             pch = 21,
             data = human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%

               #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
               filter(padj_human <= 0.05 & padj_mouse <= 0.05 & sign(Human) == sign(Mouse))) +
  
  #Add linear models
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "#4DBBD5FF", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1,
              data = human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes$symbol)) %>% 
               #Filter DEGs in both organisms, same sign
               filter(padj_human <= 0.05 & padj_mouse <= 0.05 & sign(Human) == sign(Mouse))) +
  
  #Add correlation metrics (Pearson)

    data = cor_data,

    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "white",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  #Adjust the axes range
  ylim(ylim_range) +
  xlim(xlim_range) +

  #Theme
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size =10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  labs(x = "Mouse L2FC",
       y = "Human L2FC",
       title= "Correlation plot, EngerixB,\nHuman vs Mouse")
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, matched timepoints ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Matched timepoints
timepoint_combinations <- tibble(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse)

# Loop for matched timepoints
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


#Unite
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
#Import
dge_btm_mean_process =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_dge_btm_mean_process_mouse_human.rds"))

# Calculate the correlation
cor_data <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  # Group the data by timepoint
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  
  # For each timepoint, run Pearson correlation test between Mouse and Human
  summarize(
    cor_test = list(cor.test(Mouse, Human, method = "spearman")), # store full test result as a list
    label_pos_x = max(Mouse, na.rm = TRUE),  # position for label in the plot (x = max Mouse value)
    label_pos_y = max(Human, na.rm = TRUE),  # position for label in the plot (y = max Human value)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract correlation coefficient (r) and p-value from cor_test, and create a label
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$estimate),  
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$p.value),  
    label = paste0(
      "r = ", round(cor_value, 2),      
      ", p = ", signif(p_value, 3)   
    )
  )
```

#### Summarize interindividual correlation

```{r}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, same timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(timepoint_human <= timepoint_mouse) #filter symetric pairs

timepoint_combinations
```


```{r}
# Pearson Correlation
# --- 1) Human vs Mouse (between timepoints) ---
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # get subjects from the given timepoint
    human_df <- example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    # keep the common genes
    common_process <- intersect(human_df$process, mouse_df$process)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    
    # pivot wider
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    
    # Get subjects id
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "process")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "process")
    
    # Calculate correlation for every pair of organism 1 vs organism 2
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remove NAs
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human %>% as.numeric(),
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric())
  }) %>% 
  #Summarize
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#Print
cor_human_mouse_timepoint
```


```{r}
# --- 2) Human vs Human
cor_human_human <- example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_human = timepoint)
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- example_dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint)


#Merge tables
example_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  filter(timepoint_human == timepoint_mouse) %>%

  select(!c(timepoint_mouse, timepoint_human)) %>%
```

#Performance tests
## ROC Curve
Do for one direction (up and then down)
Do one sided t test for mouse, fit, and human
Positive control: Human
Neg control: Random permutation


Import data
```{r}
#Import =============
#Import ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
#Import metadata
human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Import DEGs table
all_degs_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC") %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = timepoint /24,
         timepoint = timepoint %>% as.character())


#Pre-process data
dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human  %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol, log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val = adj_p_val)  %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarize(n = n()) %>% 
               mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 7)




#Input ======================
dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes_matched

#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

```


Inputs
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
######### Input -----
# filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
# gene_set_filename = "All_OnlyImmune"
# genes_df_input = bind_rows(
#   genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
#   genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
# )

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
gene_set_filename = "HumanDEGs_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_DEGs_all %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_DEGs_immune %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

```

Calculate ROC curve
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, direction) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

uniform_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Uniform",
         model = "Uniform")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

uniform_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Uniform",
         model = "Uniform")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, uniform_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, uniform_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "up")) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup()


roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "down")) %>%    
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup()

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "up")) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "down")) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0("Day" ,timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Uniform" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot

# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Uniform")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% fct_rev(), 
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(1),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 2, vjust = 0.5) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Uniform" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.8))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = paste(filename, gene_set_filename))

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_performance_roc_", gene_set_filename, ".png")),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)

roc_auc_curve_plot
```
